---
title: "Ladder diagnostics — telescopic ESS, acceptance, per-rung evidence variance"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)})
DIG <- "data/e743fd5"
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
## One line per rung. The raw series are a sawtooth (the telescopic window is
## discarded whenever the ladder moves) and 16 raw traces overlap into a solid
## band, so each line is the MEDIAN over blocks of 1536 iterations (6 adaptation cycles): the typical
## value a reader of the estimator would see at a random moment in that block.
BLK <- 1536   # 6 x adapt_beta_every: the sawtooth has period 256, so a block
              # that is not a multiple of it aliases into a spurious oscillation
col_rung <- scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "rung", breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15),
                                   guide = guide_colourbar(barheight = 3.2))
```

```{r panels, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=7.6}
d <- fread(file.path(DIG, "ladder_diag.csv"))
d[, blk := (as.integer(iter / BLK) + 0.5) * BLK]
b <- d[, .(ess_up = median(ess_up), ess_dn = median(ess_dn),
           acc_within = median(acc_within), acc_between = median(acc_between),
           var_tramo = median(deltaEvidence_variance)),
       by = .(i_beta, blk)]

## (a) telescopic ESS, both directions ---------------------------------------
es <- melt(b[, .(blk, i_beta, up = ess_up, down = ess_dn)],
           id.vars = c("blk", "i_beta"), variable.name = "direction",
           value.name = "ess")
pa <- ggplot(es[is.finite(ess)], aes(blk, ess, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~direction, ncol = 2) + col_rung +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "telescopic ESS (median per block)",
         subtitle = "samples the estimator actually pools; hot rungs on top") +
    theme_fig

## (b) acceptance: within-rung stretch vs between-rung swap -------------------
acc <- melt(b[, .(blk, i_beta, within = acc_within, between = acc_between)],
            id.vars = c("blk", "i_beta"), variable.name = "move", value.name = "rate")
pb <- ggplot(acc[is.finite(rate)], aes(blk, rate, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~move, ncol = 2) + col_rung +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "acceptance rate",
         subtitle = "dashed: the 0.25 limit adjust_beta tests against (hot end only)") +
    theme_fig

## (c) variance of each rung's contribution to the evidence -------------------
## (dbeta/2)^2 (Var_i logL + Var_{i+1} logL): the trapezoid tramo variance
pc <- ggplot(b[var_tramo > 0], aes(blk, var_tramo, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + col_rung +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = expression("Var of tramo contribution (nats"^2*")"),
         subtitle = "equalized within a decade once the burn-in is over") +
    theme_fig

fig <- pa / pb / pc + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
ggsave("Ladder_diagnostics.pdf", fig, width = 7.2, height = 7.6, device = pdf)
fig
```

```{r tail_table}
tl <- d[iter >= 24000,
        .(ess_up = round(median(ess_up)), ess_dn = round(median(ess_dn)),
          within = round(median(acc_within), 3), between = round(median(acc_between), 3),
          var_tramo = signif(median(deltaEvidence_variance), 3)),
        by = i_beta][order(i_beta)]
knitr::kable(tl, caption = "Tail medians (iterations >= 24000), all 16 rungs")
```
